title: Gifts for women who have everything UK: 11 treats at sale prices

description: Gifts for women who have everything, at Black Friday prices: Dyson Airwrap i.d £379, Oura Ring 5 £299, ghd Duet Style and fragrance sets from £28.
intro:
**Our best overall gift for a woman who has everything is the Oura Ring 5 at £299 on Amazon (£100 off): a stylish sleep and wellbeing tracker most people never buy for themselves. Best cheap gift: the Marc Jacobs Daisy fragrance discovery set at £33.75. Best splurge: the Dyson Airwrap i.d at £379, £100 off.**

Every price below was published on 19 or 20 November 2026, during the Black Friday sales. Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to 30 November and some prices need Prime. For more ideas, see all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

deals.name: Oura Ring 5 (black or silver)
deals.note: Tracks sleep, stress and cycles from a ring that looks like jewellery, not a gadget. £100 off. You'll need her ring size, and the app needs a monthly membership after the trial.

deals.note: Dries, curls and smooths with air rather than extreme heat. £100 off at John Lewis; Dyson's own site has the standard Airwrap at £379.99. A classic "wouldn't buy it for myself" gift.

deals.name: ghd Duet Style hot air styler
deals.note: Dries and straightens wet hair in one go. £120 off. A good alternative to the Airwrap for straighter styles.

deals.note: An LED face mask with cooling under-eye pads, for the skincare fan who has every serum. 23% off at Boots; Sephora has the Rose Glow version at £239.99.

deals.note: The best smartwatch for iPhone users, £50 off. The 46mm size is £299 if she prefers a bigger screen. Only works with an iPhone.

deals.note: Waterproof, auto-adjusting light and wireless charging, at a record-low price. Perfect for reading in the bath or in bed.

deals.note: A best-selling perfume, boxed as a gift set and £44.76 off. If she already wears it, a gift set is never wasted.

deals.name: Marc Jacobs Daisy fragrance gift set (4 × 4ml)
deals.note: Four mini bottles from the Daisy range, so she can try each scent without committing to a full bottle. Handbag-sized, and 25% off.

deals.name: Philips Hue Festavia string lights (20m)
deals.note: App-controlled tree lights with colour effects she can change from her phone. 30% off, plus an extra voucher on the listing on 19 November.

deals.name: Lego Festive Gingerbread House
deals.note: A cosy evening build that becomes a Christmas decoration every year after. A lovely small extra for a Lego fan.

body:
## How to buy for a woman who has everything

When someone already owns the basics, the best gifts are things she'd love but would never buy for herself: a beauty tool that feels indulgent, a fragrance she's admired but not splashed out on, or a gadget that makes downtime nicer. Practical upgrades she's already chosen, like her phone or kettle, rarely land.

Three quick checks help:

- **Hair type matters.** The Dyson Airwrap suits curls, waves and volume; the ghd Duet Style is better for straight, sleek styles. If you're unsure, ask a friend or check what she uses now.
- **Fragrance is personal.** A discovery set like the Marc Jacobs Daisy minis is safer than a full bottle of a new scent. If she has a signature perfume, a gift set of that one is a sure thing.
- **Know the ongoing costs.** The Oura Ring needs a monthly membership after its trial, and the Apple Watch only works with an iPhone.

## Best overall, best cheap, best splurge

- **Best overall: Oura Ring 5, £299.** It looks like jewellery, does something useful every night, and £100 off is the best price we've seen.
- **Best cheap: Marc Jacobs Daisy gift set, £33.75.** A pretty box that lets her try four scents.
- **Best splurge: Dyson Airwrap i.d, £379.** The beauty gift most people secretly want, at £100 off.

If she's a reader, pair the Kindle with a [Kindle Unlimited free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) for thousands of free books, or an [Audible free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/hz/audible/mlp) for audiobooks on the commute. Both are free to cancel. Our [Kindle Black Friday deals](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/) guide compares every model.

## Good prices to look for

- **Dyson Airwrap:** around £380 is a genuine Black Friday price; full price is about £480.
- **ghd Duet Style:** under £260 is the best it has been.
- **Oura Ring 5:** £299 in the standard finishes.
- **Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition:** under £140 is the lowest price yet.
- **Designer fragrance:** 20–25% off is normal for new scents; bigger discounts tend to be on older gift sets.

For more hair tool deals, see our [Dyson Airwrap deals](/guides/dyson-airwrap-deals-uk/) guide, and for fragrance, our [perfume gift set deals](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/). Buying for your mum? Try our [Christmas gifts for Mum](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-mum-2026/) guide.

## Prime and delivery

Some Amazon prices are for Prime members, and Prime's faster delivery helps with gifts. If you don't have it, the [Prime 30-day free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole Black Friday Week and is free to cancel.

## Buy now or wait?

Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to 30 November, and most beauty retailers run their main sales from 27 November to Cyber Monday. Prices on Dyson, ghd and fragrance usually creep back up in December, so if you've found the right gift, buy it this week.

## FAQs

### What do you buy a woman who says she wants nothing?

A treat she wouldn't buy herself: a Dyson Airwrap, an LED face mask, a luxury perfume gift set or an Oura Ring. Small, beautiful extras like a fragrance discovery set or a festive Lego build also work well.

### Dyson Airwrap or ghd Duet Style?

The Airwrap for curls, waves and volume; the ghd Duet Style for straight, smooth hair. At today's prices the ghd is £120 cheaper.

### Is the Oura Ring a good gift for her?

Yes, if you know her ring size and she's interested in sleep or wellbeing data. It needs an Oura membership after the free trial, so mention that in the card.

### What's a good gift for a woman who has everything under £50?

The Marc Jacobs Daisy gift set (£33.75), the Lego Festive Gingerbread House (£28), or a Kindle Unlimited or Audible free trial added to a small present.

### Will these prices go lower before Christmas?

Unlikely. Black Friday to Cyber Monday is usually the cheapest point before Christmas, and most prices rise again in December.
